pie_de_post.es: Te van a juzgar igual. Que sea por estar en tu mejor versión.
pie_de_post.en: They'll judge you anyway. Let it be for being your best version.

texto.en: You start taking care of yourself. They judge you.

texto.es: Se te nota el cambio. Te juzgan.
texto.en: The change shows. They judge you.

texto.es: Dejas el alcohol el finde. Te juzgan.
texto.en: You skip the drinks on the weekend. They judge you.

texto.es: El lunes estás a tope. Te juzgan.
texto.en: You're on fire on Monday. They judge you.

texto.es: Te vas a dormir a las 23h. Te juzgan.
texto.en: You're in bed by 11pm. They judge you.
You get twice as much done. They judge you.

texto.es: Inviertes en salud, no en cosas. Te juzgan.
texto.en: You invest in health, not things. They judge you.
You live life your way. They judge you.

texto.es: Construyes la vida que querías. Te juzgan.
texto.en: You build the life you wanted. They judge you.

texto.es: Te van a juzgar igual. Que sea por tu mejor versión.
texto.en: They'll judge you anyway. Make it your best version.
